description: Shared journey clock; CANOPY pollution, temperature and traffic recordings repeat every 600 s across full breathing-model coverage. Fields sampled at walker position and replay phase; journey and breathing state never reset. Tracer-derived PM2.5 scenario is uncalibrated, not a forecast; vehicle emissions are not simulated. Local clear-sky solar irradiance follows the selected June/December scenario day at departure clock time plus elapsed time, without replay. Wave branching and traversal use a labelled air-plus-solar warming proxy; CVAE still uses native air temperature.
purpose: Opt-in healthy-route research only; not the canonical London timeline or a weather forecast.
